backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented responsive-design features (Header, Hero, Services, About, etc.) to their source files, component dependencies, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of every frontend source file, describing each component's purpose, responsive behavior, and key hooks used.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, primary, card, sidebar, and chart tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the GrowteX Ventures app with title, meta description, keywords, and Open Graph tags, mounting the React app at the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that composes all page sections (Header, Hero, Services, About, Process, Testimonials, Contact, Footer) with a ScrollProgressBar and overflow-x-hidden wrapper.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section with a responsive split text/illustration layout, parallax effect disabled on mobile, and animated stat counters using useCountUp triggered on viewport entry.
frontend/src/components/AnimationWrapper: Scroll-triggered animation wrapper using IntersectionObserver that supports fade-up, fade-in, slide-left, and slide-right animations with optional per-child stagger delays and prefers-reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with a responsive stacked info panel and contact form, clickable phone/email links, touch-friendly inputs, and a simulated async form submission handler.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with a brand column, three link columns (Services, Company, Contact), social media icons, and a bottom bar with copyright and a Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top navigation header with a logo, desktop nav links with smooth-scroll, a 'Book a Free Call' CTA button, and a collapsible mobile hamburger menu that becomes opaque on scroll.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a parallax background image, animated headline/subtext/CTA buttons, and a stats row showing client and growth metrics.
frontend/src/components/ProcessSection.t: Displays a four-step agency process (Discovery, Strategy, Execute, Scale) with animated cards, connector lines that are vertical on mobile and horizontal on desktop.
frontend/src/components/ScrollProgressBa: Fixed top progress bar that fills horizontally based on the user's scroll position using the useScrollProgress hook.
Renders a grid of eight service cards with scroll-depth-based parallax transforms, each showing an icon, title, and description, wrapped in AnimationWrapper for entrance animations.
frontend/src/components/TestimonialsSect: Renders a responsive grid of six client testimonial cards with star ratings, quotes, and author info, wrapped in animation components.
frontend/src/components/VideoPortfolioSe: Displays a cinematic four-chapter story portfolio section with hover-animated thumbnail cards and summary stats about client growth.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUp.ts: Custom hook that animates a number from 0 to a target value over a given duration using requestAnimationFrame with an ease-out cubic curve, respecting reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context and custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallax.ts: Custom hook that returns a scroll-based translateY offset for parallax effects, throttled with requestAnimationFrame and disabled on mobile or reduced-motion settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollDepth.ts: Custom hook that returns a normalized 0–1 value representing how close a referenced element is to the viewport center, updated on scroll via requestAnimationFrame.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollProgress.ts: Custom hook that tracks and returns the current page scroll progress as a percentage (0–100), updated on scroll using requestAnimationFrame.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining Tailwind base/utilities, a dark green-tinted OKLCH CSS variable theme, base typography styles, scrollbar customization, and reduced-motion overrides.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with React Query's QueryClientProvider and the InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, Plus Jakarta Sans fonts, border radius variables, glow box shadows, and several keyframe animations. Also registers the tailwindcss-animate, @tailwindcss/typography, and @tailwindcss/container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current build state (version 15) of the GrowteX Ventures single-page website, recording the project summary, architectural notes, known issues, and a list of existing implemented features. Serves as a planning/continuity document describing the dark agency-themed design, services, contact details, and responsiveness goals.
